messages.subject: Time recording — October narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

Our records show unposted time for October on several matters. Please ensure all narratives are submitted by 17:00 on Wednesday so we can run the month-end bills. Contact Accounts with any queries.

Accounts
